prompt: Accounts need passwords. Add `register(String email, String password)` and `boolean logIn(String email, String password)` to `AccountService` in src/accounts/AccountService.java. Hash with PBKDF2 (`SecretKeyFactory` "PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256" from javax.crypto) and a random salt from `SecureRandom`; never store the password itself. `App.buildService()` in src/accounts/App.java must keep returning a ready service.
